note: WTH-02 sound tuning (display only; no sound touches the simulation). All sounds are synthesised in code (scripts/poc/audio/poc_audio.gd): no external material. master and categories are linear 0..1 gains. Ambient sound is softened (calm_factor) while the game is paused / a menu is open / the viewpoint is shown, and action sounds are not played then. 'muted' is only the first-run default: the M key toggles and the choice is kept in user://poc_ui_settings.json. Reversible initial values.
